analysis: The loss-only experiment completed successfully but achieved macro validation HR@10 of 0.3900, below the supplied previous result of 0.4012 by 0.0112. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.440, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.450, Electronics 0.390, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.280. CDs_and_Vinyl improved from the reported previous 0.250 but remained the weakest category. Replacing independent BCE with cross-entropy over one positive and 32 sampled negatives did not improve the aggregate result; stronger competition among sampled candidates was insufficient under the retained training settings. These results do not establish the cause of the regression. Allocated GPU time was 414.18 seconds.
code_summary: Each category independently trains one SASRec model with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings, learned positions, maximum sequence length 128, two causal attention blocks, one attention head, feed-forward residual layers, and dropout 0.5. Training samples user prefixes and 32 negatives excluding training-history items, then applies mean cross-entropy with the positive at index zero, temperature 1, and no label smoothing. AdamW, mixed precision, gradient clipping, seed 42, validation cadence, and early stopping remain unchanged; SASREC_EPOCHS defaults to 200. Prediction routes among all four categories and loads exactly one best-validation checkpoint per category, scoring candidates by embedding dot products. No ensembles, auxiliary scorers, or inference changes were introduced.
